title: BD Arena Code Patterns — Light
purpose: Cross-project code motifs common to BD arenas: MDL decides, DCC orchestration, workers, manifests, conservative grafting, reproducibility.

blocks.title: Captain/graft rule
blocks.text: Crossword arena pattern: keep the proven captain/base; graft only selected promising extras; extras are conservative by default and arena-zerorable; let MDL decide which grafted genes survive.

blocks.title: Wide search-space rule
blocks.text: AMR arena pattern: continue from a real code path, not toy rewrite; keep wide search-space, workers, resume/checkpoint, DCC modes, and reproducibility intact.

blocks.title: ARC solver pattern
blocks.text: ARC arena pattern: pipeline from input features to primitive candidates to MDL score to DCC trace to train-fit/leave-one-validation/test prediction, with outputs including results, summary, failures, candidates, report, manifest.

blocks.title: No online/no hidden calls pattern
blocks.text: Several BD arenas explicitly avoid online calls and LLM calls during benchmark execution. When a system uses LLM/API calls, this must be explicit in logs, costs, and claims.

blocks.title: DCC-like orchestration
blocks.text: Across projects, DCC means coordinating multiple signals/operators rather than trusting one monolithic heuristic. MentalArena should be DCC-like: orchestrate roles, conflicts, context, and tests, but keep BD in control.

usage_instruction: Use only what is relevant. Cite CTX ids when relying on this context. If context is insufficient or conflicts with the task, say so explicitly.
